record.context_brief: Invariant measures on closed subsets of Euclidean space
record.original_question: Determine all Borel probability measures on the space Cl(R^d) of closed subsets of R^d that are invariant under the natural action of SL_d(R), and likewise determine all such invariant Borel probability measures for the action of the affine group ASL_d(R).

evidence.quote: Let d ≥ 1 be an integer. Denote by Cl(Rd) the set of all closed subsets of Rd with respect to the Chabauty–Fell topology ... Problem 2.8.1 (J. Marklof) Determine all SLd (R)-invariant Borel probability measures on Cl(Rd) and similarly for the ASLd (R) action.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\geq 1$ be an integer, and let $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ denote the set of all closed subsets of $\mathbb{R}^d$, equipped with the Chabauty–Fell topology (the topology generated by the sub-basis $\{F\in\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d): F\cap K=\emptyset\}$ for compact $K\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ together with $\{F\in\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d): F\cap U\neq\emptyset\}$ for open $U\subset\mathbb{R}^d$); with this topology $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ is a compact metrizable space. The special linear group $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$ acts on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ by $g\cdot F=\{gx:x\in F\}$, and the affine special linear group $\mathrm{ASL}_d(\mathbb{R})=\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})\ltimes\mathbb{R}^d$ acts by $(g,v)\cdot F=\{gx+v:x\in F\}$.

Classify (i.e., describe explicitly) all Borel probability measures on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ that are invariant under the $\mathrm{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})$-action, and likewise classify all Borel probability measures on $\mathrm{Cl}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ that are invariant under the $\mathrm{ASL}_d(\mathbb{R})$-action.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches reveal a body of related work (invariant random subgroups, work of Marklof–Strömbergsson on quasicrystals, Solan, and Weiss–collaborators on dynamical questions of Danzer/Gowers type), but no source presents a complete classification of all SL_d(R)- or ASL_d(R)-invariant Borel probability measures on the space of closed subsets of R^d. The full classification appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On problems of Danzer and Gowers and dynamics on the space of closed subsets of R^d
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the ASL_d(R) action on the space of closed subsets of R^d and uses partial measure-classification results, indicating the general problem is not closed.
status_evidence.claim: Related dynamical results on closed subsets of R^d, but classification not completed.

status_evidence.title: Invariant random subgroups on certain orbits
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to study invariant measures on Chabauty-type spaces of closed subsets/subgroups under linear group actions.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research suggests the classification problem is still under investigation.
